support.locationTitle: Authentic Medan Souvenirs, Straight from North Sumatra
support.locationText: Our store is in {locality}, on the way to {landmark} — perfect for picking up Medan souvenirs before your flight. Need delivery? We ship to cities across Indonesia with your chosen courier, or you can pick up at the store with no shipping cost.
support.faq1Q: Where is the Rasa Medan souvenir shop?
support.faq1A: Our store is at {address}, near {landmark}. Opening hours: {hours}.
support.faq2Q: How do I order Medan souvenirs from Rasa Medan?
support.faq2A: Pick products from the catalog, add them to your cart, and check out without an account. Your order gets an Order ID and is forwarded to our WhatsApp to confirm stock and payment.
support.faq3A: Yes. We ship to cities across Indonesia with your chosen courier. A shipping estimate appears at checkout, and orders ship the day after payment is verified.
support.faq4Q: Can I pick up at the store?
support.faq4A: Yes. Choose Self pickup at checkout — no shipping cost. Pickup is at the store address during opening hours.
support.faq5A: Payment is made via WhatsApp using QRIS or bank transfer. Orders are processed once we receive your payment proof.
